[[Mallyx's Edge]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] obtained from the [[Citadel Chest]], which spawns after defeating [[Mallyx the Unyielding]] in [[The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]].

:[[Slashing damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Double [[adrenaline]] on hit (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +30
